joana.name: Joana
joana.appreciation: Everything! Mainly your energy, the natural flow of our conversations, and your unique self. You are such a great colleague, someone we can always rely on while also having lots of fun together.
joana.memory: I’ll always remember your smile, your sense of fun, and of course, Lotta always close by!
joana.wishes: I hope you can continue to be yourself, feel energized by your work, and bring all the wonderful value that I know you will add to your new team.

murielle.name: Murielle
murielle.appreciation: You are such a nice guy, always friendly, approachable and genuinely interested in the people around you. I really enjoy your positive attitude and the easy way you connect with others. It has been a real pleasure having you as a colleague!
murielle.memory: I remember that I was working in the open space and had some issues with my audio. You joined the call and started saying “Hello, hello!”... only to realise that everyone in the open space could hear you. Everyone burst out laughing, and my first reflex was to simply leave the call! Definitely a moment I won't forget!
murielle.wishes: Stay true to yourself, because that's what makes you special! Connecting with people, showing genuine interest:  that's your real strength and something you do so naturally. I wish you lots of fun, success and great people around you in this next chapter. Keep being you!

ilonka.name: Ilonka
ilonka.appreciation: I have really enjoyed working with you. You are someone we can always rely on, no matter what comes up. I  appreciate your perspective, your way of looking at things, and the openness you bring to conversations. It has always been great to exchange ideas with you and to have you as part of the team.
ilonka.memory: What I will remember is your positive attitude and the smile you bring with you. You have a way of making things feel a little lighter and creating a good atmosphere around you.I will definitely miss having you in the team, and of course I will miss Lotta, too!
ilonka.wishes: I wish you all the very best for your new role and this next chapter. I am sure you will bring the same positive energy, reliability, and valuable perspective to your new team. They can truly be happy to have you! I hope the new role brings you many exciting opportunities, great people to work with, and lots of moments to enjoy.

borke.name: Borke
borke.appreciation: Your positivity, your energy and your ability to stay true to yourself is a real super power. You have been such a great addition to the team and I will really miss your smiles and giggles in our meetings.
borke.memory: The moments when you just giggle and say something funny. And I will miss Lotta in the team!
borke.wishes: Please never try to be someone else but always be yourself. You shine and you make others shine and you should always keep your attitude to life.

natalia.name: Natalia
natalia.appreciation: You’re such a social and open person, and I really enjoy how easy it is to talk to you about literally anything, whether it’s in the office or over lunch. You have a great sense of humor, and you’re also incredibly creative
natalia.memory: And I’ll always remember the person with the pudding in the canteen, because of whom everyone now has to weigh their pudding.
natalia.wishes: wish you a smooth start in this crazy world of HR Consulting! 😄 And of course, I hope you’ll have colleagues who are just as nice as us. 😉

dominic.name: Dominic
dominic.appreciation: I really enjoyed your positive energy, humor, and how easy and open our conversations always felt. I especially appreciated your honesty and openness, so please don´t ever lose that! You also played a big part in making me feel welcomed and comfortable in the team from the very beginning.
dominic.memory: I still remembere the first time I met Lotta and how warmly she greeted both of us. I was also really impressed by how naturally and effortlessly you moderated events, even without much preparation. You always came across confident and at ease, which is definetly a real strength of yours!
dominic.wishes: I wish you all the best for your new role and hope that you´ll have a great start! Furthermore I hope that you meet lots of wonderful people and feel energized by your work. And most importantly, keep your positive energy, curiosity and sense of humor!

philipp.name: Philipp
philipp.appreciation: From day one, you made me feel very welcome in the team. Whenever I had a question, you were always there with a quick answer and ready to help!
philipp.memory: I really enjoyed seeing all the energy and creativity you put into your LearningHUB app. It makes it even more fitting that, for your farewell, you now get to experience a little gamified app yourself! 😉
philipp.wishes: I wish you a great start in your new role and lots of exciting projects, great people and new challenges. Stay exactly as positive, creative and approachable as I got to know you!

acelya.name: Açelya
acelya.appreciation: No matter what the topic is, you make every conversation seem effortless. With him, no one feels left out, which I admire a lot!
acelya.memory: We once took Lotta for a walk during lunch break and were headed to a bakery. While you were inside, I looked after Lotta, and guess what, it was my first time ever giving a dog treats! It might seem like a little thing, but for me this was very wholesome, I hope we can repeat this again someday!
acelya.wishes: I wish that you will receive the praise and recognition for your achievements, because you deserve it! What you do matters a lot, please don't forget that. And outisde of work, I hope you are going to see all the places that you want to see in the world... or wherever your curiosity takes you!
